t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Hayɩ me-eso, menke aseyɩdedu. Ɉlahɩ-m se mansumu-ŋ ne mansamu-ŋ. Manay lzeleyɔ se menke ejamtu ne ŋke dom, mentisi man-kutingɩ yao ne lɩ-fum yao. Êsɔ nooyu feyi dɛdɔ pitasina-ŋ; ezɛ ne-ŋeke. Na weyi ŋlùzy eye kuhtɔŋ taa ŋ, Na weyi ŋwe na-ti yɔɔ Byaki eyaa ñuŋ kade taa.
